word_limit_counts: Including footnotes; excluding abstract, references, tables and figures
required_sections: Data availability statement at end of manuscript
Competing interests declaration on title page
notes: Guidelines page last updated 2024-07-30. Cover letter with novelty paragraph and Highlights file (3-5 bullets, max 85 chars) required. British or American spelling, consistently. Headings numbered to two levels only; only initial word capitalised in headings. No pre-decimal zeros for p and r. Accuracy/proportion data must use categorical models (satisfied: Bernoulli GLMMs). LMEs must include by-participant and by-item intercepts. Max 5 tables and 5 figures; extra material to Supplementary Materials. Alt-text/accessibility descriptions expected; colour contrast per WCAG 2.1 AA.
